# JEE Quiz Studio — Full Analysis & Improvement Plan

> Full code audit of `Happ3ns/JEE-Quiz-Generator` and the live site at `happ3ns.github.io/JEE-Quiz-Generator/`

---

## What You Already Built Well ✅

Before the improvements — this is genuinely impressive for a student project:

- **~900+ questions** (162 static + ~740 procedurally generated via templates)
- **Mock exam mode** with Chemistry → Physics → Maths sections and per-subject navigation
- **Weak-topic tracking** using localStorage — surfaces your 3 worst topics on the home screen
- **Question map** (live grid showing answered/correct/wrong per question during a session)
- **Per-topic accuracy breakdown** in results, persisted across sessions
- **Timer badge** that turns red when time is running low
- **`prefers-reduced-motion`** and keyboard accessibility (focus rings, `aria-pressed`, `aria-label`)
- **Zero dependencies** — single HTML file, works offline, deployable anywhere

---

## Issues Found (Bugs & Bugs)

### 🔴 Critical — Wrong Answer in Existing Questions

| # | Question | Current Answer | Correct Answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `"If a car travels 100 m in 10 s…"` | `answer: 2` → "20 m/s" | Should be `answer: 1` → "10 m/s" |
| 2 | `"Mean of 2,4,6,8"` | `answer: 0` → "4" | Mean is **(2+4+6+8)/4 = 5**, so `answer: 1` |
| 3 | `"det of [[2,3],[1,4]] is…"` | `answer: 2` → "7" | 2×4 − 3×1 = **5**, so `answer: 0` |

### 🟡 Logic Bug — Mock Mode Question Fallback

In `buildQuizPool()`, when mock mode runs short of questions for a subject, the fallback pool expands but **does not re-filter by subject**, which can silently inject wrong-subject questions into a section.

### 🟡 Logic Bug — Supplemental Answer Rotation

In `createSupplementalQuestion()`:
```js
const answer = serial % 4;
```
`serial` is `output.length` at call time — it always increases, so answers cycle through A, B, C, D in a fixed pattern across the entire supplemental bank. A student who notices the pattern can exploit it.

### 🟡 UX Bug — Timer Keeps Running After Answer

The per-question countdown (`timerId`) continues even after the user selects an answer and the "Next" button appears. It doesn't pause. On mobile, users sometimes hit "Next" with a few seconds left and the timer fires `autoAdvance()` almost immediately after.

---

## Improvements by Priority

---

### Priority 1 — Fix Wrong Answers (Do This First)

This is the most critical fix. Wrong answers in a revision tool actively harm the person using it.

**Fix the 3 confirmed wrong answers** listed above in the BANK array.

---

### Priority 2 — Add Negative Marking (JEE Realism)

The README even lists this as a TODO. Without negative marking, your app doesn't match the real JEE experience.

**JEE Mains scheme:**
- Correct: **+4**
- Wrong: **−1**
- Skipped: **0**

What to add:
- A "Skip" button alongside "Next"
- Score display using the JEE formula
- Option for "JEE marking" vs "Simple" mode

---

### Priority 3 — Export Progress as CSV / JSON

Currently, clearing browser data wipes everything. This is a huge pain point for a revision tool.

Add a small **Export** button on the results screen (and in the sidebar) that downloads:
```
attempt_history.json
```
And an **Import** button to restore from that file on a new device.

---

### Priority 4 — Add Math Rendering (KaTeX / MathJax)

Right now, math is written as plain Unicode: `hν`, `₀`, `Ksp`, `½CV²`. This works in many cases, but:
- Fractions look wrong (`½kx²` renders inconsistently)
- Subscripts/superscripts in question text render incorrectly on some devices
- Complex equations like `1/f = 1/v − 1/u` are hard to read

**Add KaTeX** (single CDN `<script>` tag) so questions can use:
```
$K_{sp} = s^2$, $v = u + at$, $\int_0^\infty$
```
This immediately makes the app look like a **serious academic tool** rather than a plain-text quiz.

---

### Priority 5 — Spaced Repetition Scheduler

This is listed in your README as future work. For SMU/NUS admission context, this is the feature that turns a quiz app into a **study system**.

Simple implementation:
- After each wrong answer, store the question ID and a "review date" (tomorrow by default)
- After each correct answer, double the interval (2 days → 4 days → 8 days…)
- Show a "Questions due for review today: N" badge on the home screen

This feature alone would make it worth adding to your portfolio as a **product decision**, not just code.

---

### Priority 6 — Fix the Portfolio Site Link

Your portfolio at `happ3ns.github.io` currently only shows a GitHub link for JEE-Quiz-Studio. The card does not say the app is **live and usable right now.**

The card text should be:
```
"Zero-dependency quiz app. Try it live →"
```
With a direct link to `happ3ns.github.io/JEE-Quiz-Generator/`.

---

### Priority 7 — Add Question Count Badge to README

Your README doesn't mention that the bank has 900+ questions. Add this to the top:

```
> 900+ questions across Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (Easy → Hard)
```

This matters for anyone evaluating the project — including SMU admissions readers who search for the repo.

---

## Quick Wins (15 Minutes Each)

| Fix | Why |
|---|---|
| Add `<meta name="description">` to `<head>` | Currently missing — search engines and link previews show nothing |
| Add GitHub Topics to repo | Currently none. Add: `jee`, `quiz`, `study-tools`, `javascript`, `github-pages` |
| Add repo description on GitHub | Currently blank. Add: "JEE practice studio — 900+ questions, weak-topic tracking, mock exam mode. No dependencies." |
| Fix the h1 title | Shows "JEE Quiz Generator" but the README calls it "JEE Quiz Studio" — pick one |

---

## Summary

```
🔴 Fix now    — 3 wrong answers in question bank
🔴 Fix now    — answer rotation exploit in supplemental questions
🟡 This week  — negative marking / skip button (JEE realism)
🟡 This week  — export / import progress
🟡 This week  — KaTeX math rendering
🟢 This month — spaced repetition scheduler
🟢 This month — update portfolio to show live demo link
⚡ 15 minutes — meta description, GitHub topics, repo description, consistent title
```
